s1.syndrome_frame: Abdominal pain with liver dysfunction and a large cystic liver tumor
salient_findings: Right dorsal pain
Elevated alkaline phosphatase and γ-glutamyl transferase
Large cystic liver tumor with solid components
Depressed liver function
Tumor compressing portal vein and hepatic vein
key_facts: Negative hepatitis B and C viral markers
Normal α-fetoprotein, PIVKA-II, CEA, and CA19-9 levels
16 cm diameter cystic tumor in the liver
Tumor compressing portal vein and hepatic vein
FDG uptake in solid components of the tumor

shortlist.label: Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of the liver
shortlist.why_kept: Large cystic liver tumor with elevated DUPAN-2 and CA125 levels, consistent with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma

shortlist.label: Biliary cystadenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cystic liver tumor with solid components and elevated tumor markers, similar to biliary cystadenocarcinoma

shortlist.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Liver dysfunction and large cystic tumor, possible cholangiocarcinoma with cystic degeneration

shortlist.label: Hepatic sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large cystic tumor with solid components and FDG uptake, possible sarcoma of the liver

shortlist.label: Hepatobiliary cystadenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Cystic liver tumor with septa and solid components, similar to hepatobiliary cystadenocarcinoma

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with a large cystic tumor in the liver, elevated DUPAN-2 and CA125 levels, and FDG uptake in the solid components of the tumor, along with the tumor's characteristic appearance on imaging, are consistent with mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of the liver.

rejected.label: Biliary cystadenocarcinoma
rejected.why: While similar, biliary cystadenocarcinoma is less likely given the specific tumor markers and imaging characteristics presented.

rejected.label: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
rejected.why: This diagnosis is less likely due to the cystic nature of the tumor and the presence of mucinous components, which are not typical of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Hepatic sarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's characteristics, including its cystic components and the presence of mucin, do not align well with hepatic sarcoma.

rejected.label: Hepatobiliary cystadenocarcinoma
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, but the specific details provided point more directly to mucinous cystadenocarcinoma of the liver as the most precise diagnosis.
